questions.question: Vaibhav can do a piece of work in 60 days. He works there for 15 days and then Sandeep alone finishes the remaining work in 30 days. In how many days will Vaibhav and Sandeep working together finish the work?
questions.solution:
Given:

Vaibhav can do a piece of work = 60 days

Number of days Vaibhav works = 15 days

Sandeep alone finish the remaining work = 30 days

Formula used:

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Total work = 60

Let efficiency of Sandeep be x, then

15 + 30x = 60

30x = 60 – 15 = 45

x = 45/30 = 1.5

**Vaibhav and Sandeep together can complete the whole work in = 60/(1 + 1.5) = 60/2.5 = 24 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Suppose Sandeep can complete the whole work in x days. 

According to the question,

15/60 + 30/x = 1

⇒ 30/x = 1 – 1/4

⇒ 30/x = 3/4

⇒ x = 40 days

Vaibhav and Sandeep together can complete the work in 1 day = 1/60 + 1/40

⇒ (2 + 3)/120 = 5/120 = 1/24

∴ Vaibhav and Sandeep together can complete the whole work in 24 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Calculation:

Time taken by Vaibhav to complete the work = (60/15) = 4 days

Number of days Sandeep works = (1 – 1/4) = 3/4 days

Time taken by Sandeep to complete the work = (4/3 × 30) = 40 days

Now,

LCM of 60 and 40 is 120

Efficiency of Vaibhav = (120/60) = 2 units/day

Efficiency of Sandeep = (120/40) = 3 units/day

Time taken by Vaibhav and Sandeep together to complete a work = [120/(2 + 3)]

⇒ 120/5 days

⇒ 24 days

∴ The required days is 24 days.

questions.question: Vivek can do a certain work in 14 days. Vishal is 75% more efficient than Vivek. How many days will Vishal alone take to do the same work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Efficiency** (Vishal : Vivek) = 175% : 100% = 7 : 4.

Since **Time** is inversely proportional to efficiency, **Time Ratio** (Vishal : Vivek) = 4 : 7.

Given **Vivek** takes 14 days, so 7 units = 14 days ⇒ 1 unit = 2 days.

**Vishal** takes 4 units = 4 × 2 = 8 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Time taken by **Vivek** = 14 days. **Vishal** is 75% more efficient than **Vivek**.

**Formula:** Total Work = Efficiency × Time | Time = Total Work ÷ Efficiency

⇒ Let **Efficiency** of **Vivek** = 4 units/day

⇒ **Efficiency** of **Vishal** = 175% of 4 = 7 units/day

⇒ **Total Work** = 14 × 4 = 56 units

⇒ Time taken by **Vishal** = 56 ÷ 7 = 8 days

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion Rule

For a constant amount of work, efficiency and time are inversely proportional: E₁ × T₁ = E₂ × T₂.

Work and Wages

Wages are generally distributed in the ratio of the efficiency of the workers or the actual work done by them.

Combined Efficiency

When two or more people work together, their individual efficiencies are added to find the total rate of work (Eₜₒₜₐₗ = E₁ + E₂).</p

questions.question: Ranjeet drives his car at an average speed of 50 km/hr and reaches his destination in 8 hours. Rahman covers the same distance in 5 hours. If Ranjeet increases his speed by 10 km/hr and Rahman increases his speed by 20 km/hr, then what will be the difference in time taken by them to reach their destination?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Ranjeet = 50 km/hr

**Calculation:**

Total distance covered by Ranjeet in 8 hrs = 50 × 8 = 400 km

Speed of Rahman = 400/5 = 80 km/hr

New speed of Ranjeet = 50 + 10 = 60 km/hr

New speed of Rahman = 80 + 20 = 100 km/hr

Time taken by Ranjeet to cover 400 km distance = 400/60 = 6 hr 40 min

Time taken by Rahman to cover 400 km distance = 400/100 = 4 hr

Required difference = 6 hr + 40 min – 4 hr = 2 hours 40 minutes

questions.question: A, B and C are partners in a business. A, whose capital has been used for 5 months, claims 1/7 of the profit. B whose capital has been used for 7 months, claims 1/5 of the profit. C has invested Rs. 4,600 for 9 months. How much capital did A contribute?

B capital usage = 7 months

Capital × Time = Profit

**Calculation:**

Let the total profit be 35 unit.

Profit of B = 1/5 × 35 = 7 unit

Profit of C = 35 – 5 – 7 = 23 unit

Let the capital of A and B are x and y, respectively.

Capital × Time = Profit

⇒ 5x : 7y ∶ 4600 × 9 = 5 : 7 : 23

According to the question

⇒ 23 unit = 4600 × 9

⇒ 1 unit = (4600 × 9)/23

⇒ 5 unit = 5x

⇒ [(4600 × 9)/23] × 5 = 5x

⇒ x = [(4600 × 9)/23] × 5/5 = 1800

∴The correct answer is **Rs.1800.**

questions.question: The average age of husband, wife and child 7 years ago was 42 years and that of wife and child 9 years ago was 36 years. The present age of the husband is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total present age of **Husband (H) + Wife (W) + Child (C)** = (42 + 7) × 3 = 49 × 3 = 147 years.

Total present age of **Wife (W) + Child (C)** = (36 + 9) × 2 = 45 × 2 = 90 years.

Present age of **Husband** = 147 − 90 = 57 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 57 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b64af18eeb1d582fdfcf8e1015afdf8b9bd77cff468f24ffa467dfeeb3bddbd.png] 

**Given:** Average age of **H, W, C** (7 years ago) = 42 years; Average age of **W, C** (9 years ago) = 36 years.

**Formula Used:** Total Sum = Average × Number of entities

⇒ Sum of ages of **H, W, C** (7 years ago) = 42 × 3 = 126

⇒ Sum of their **Present ages** = 126 + (7 × 3) = 126 + 21 = 147 years

⇒ Sum of ages of **W, C** (9 years ago) = 36 × 2 = 72

⇒ Sum of their **Present ages** = 72 + (9 × 2) = 72 + 18 = 90 years

⇒ **Husband present age** = (H + W + C) − (W + C) = 147 − 90 = 57

**∴ The correct answer is 57 years.**

**__Additional Information__**

Effect of Time on Average

If the average age of n people was X years, k years ago, then their current average age is (X + k) years.

Net Change in Sum

When calculating the sum of ages after 't' years for 'n' people, add (n × t) to the previous total sum.

Average Concept

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).</p

questions.question: If x⁴ + x⁻⁴ = 2599, then one of the values of x – x⁻¹, where x > 0, is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x⁴ + x⁻⁴ = 2599

**Calculation:**

As we know,

(x² + 1/x²)² = x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2

⇒ (x² + 1/x)² = 2599 + 2 = 2601

⇒ (x² + 1/x²) = √2601 = 51

Again, (x – 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² – 2

⇒ (x – 1/x)² = 51 – 2 = 49

⇒ x – x⁻¹ = √49 = 7

∴ The correct answer is** 7**.

questions.question: A single equivalent discount to three successive discounts of 10%, 16% and 25% is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discounts = 10%, 16%, 25%

**Formula used:**

Discount = [(MP - SP)/MP] × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the number be 100.

Number after discount = 100 × 90/100 × 84/100 × 75/100 = 56.7

∴ Single equivalent discount = [(100 – 56.7)/100] × 100 = 43.3%

∴ The correct answer is **43.3%**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

10% = 1/10, 16% = 4/25 & 25% = 1/4

∴ Required discount = (1000 – 567)/1000 × 100 = 43.3%

questions.question: A certain sum of money amounts to Rs. 8,928 in two years and to Rs. 10,224 in 3(1)/(2) years, both at simple interest. The rate of interest per annum is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount after 2 years = Rs 8928

Amount after 3(1/2) years = Rs 10,224

**Concept used:**

SI = PRT/100

A = P + SI

P → princiapl R → rate of interest T → time

**Calculation:**

SI for 3/2 years = amount after 3(1/2) years - amount after 2 years =10224 – 8928 = 1296

SI for 3/2 years = 1296

SI for 2 years = 1296 × (2/3) × 2 = 1728

Principal = 8928 – 1728 = 7200

R= (100 × SI) / (P × T)

R = (100 × 1728) / (7200 × 2) = 12%

**∴ The rate of interest is 12%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Amount after 2 years = Rs 8928

Amount after 3(1/2) years = Rs 10,224

⇒ A = P +2 SI ------------(1)

⇒ A = P + 7/2SI -------------(2)

⇒ 3/2 SI = 10224 - 8928

⇒ 3/2 SI = 1296

⇒ SI = (1296 × 2)/3

⇒ SI = Rs. 864

Now,putting value of SI in eq(2) we get.

⇒ P = 10224 - 7/2 × 864

⇒ P = 7200

Rate = Interest(1 year)/Principal 

Rate = 864/7200 × 100

= 12

Rate % = 12 %

questions.question: Two persons A and B are paid a total of Rs. 2,040 per week by their employer. If B is paid 140 percent of the sum paid to A, then how much is A paid per week?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A + B total money per week = Rs. 2040

B's money = 140% of A's Money

**Calculation:**

Total paid of A and B = 2040

∵ 140% = 7/5

Let the sum paid to A be 5x.

Sum paid of B = 5x × (7/5) = 7x

7x + 5x = 2040

⇒ 12x = 2040

⇒ x = 170

Sum paid to A = 5 &am

questions.question: A cuboidal tank has 25000 litres of water. If the depth of the cuboid is 1/5 of its length and breadth is 1/8 of its length, then the length of the tank is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Volume of tank = 25000 litres

Depth of cuboid = 1/5 of length

Breadth of cuboid = 1/8 of length

Formula∶ 

Volume of a cuboid = lbh

**Calculation:**

As we know,

1000 litres = 1 m³

25000 litres = 25 m³

Let the length of the tank be x m.

Depth of tank = x × 1/5 = x/5

Breadth of tank = x × 1/8 = x/8

**Formula****∶** Volume of a cuboid = lbh

x × x/5 × x/8 = 25

⇒ x³ = 5³ × 2³

⇒ x = 5 × 2 = 10 m

∴ The correct answer is **10 m**.

questions.question: The speed of a train is 2(1)/(6) times the speed of a car. The car covers 486 km in 9 hours. How much distance will the train cover in 6 hours?
questions.solution:
Distance = 486 and time = 9 hours

Speed of the car = 486/9 = 54 km/hr

Speed of the train = 54 × (13/6) = 117 km/hr

Distance covered by train in 6 hrs = 117 × 6 = 702 km

questions.question: The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 8 and 48 respectively. If the ratio of the two numbers is 2 : 3, then the larger of the two numbers is:
questions.solution:
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Ratio of two number = 2x : 3x

HCF of 2x and 3x is x.

According to the question, x = 8

So, the larger number = 3 × 8 = 24

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The HCF of the two numbers = 8

The LCM of the two numbers = 48

The ratio of two numbers = 2x : 3x

**Formula used:**

Product of both the number = HCF × LCM

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

2x × 3x = 8 × 48

⇒ x² = (8 × 48) / (2 × 3)

⇒ x² = 4 × 16 

∴ x = √64 = 8

The largest number = 3x

⇒ 3 × 8

⇒ 24 

**∴ The largest** **number is 24.**

questions.question: If sin θ – cos θ = 0, 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of sin⁴ θ + cos⁴ θ is:
questions.solution:
sin θ – cos θ = 0

sin θ = cos θ

So, the value of θ = 45°

⇒ sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ

⇒ sin⁴45 + cos⁴45

⇒ (1/√2)⁴ + (1/√2)⁴

⇒ 1/4 + 1/4 = 1/2

questions.question: A tank is filled in 4 hours by three pipes A, B and C. The pipe C is twice as fast as B and pipe B is thrice as fast as A. How much time will pipe A alone take to fill the tank?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of pipe A be 1 unit/hour

Efficiency of pipe B = 3 units/hour

Efficiency of C = 6 units/hour

Total efficiency of A, B, and C = 1 + 3 + 6 = 10

They finish in 4 hours 

⇒ Total work = (1 + 3 + 6) × 4 = 40 units

Pipe A alone can fill the whole tank in = 40/1 = 40 hrs.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 hours.**
